title: Chariots of fire as angelic vehicles

tellings.quote: However, in the narrative, you have these other vehicles that are called the chariots of God or the chariots of Israel or the chariots of fire.

plain: Tim Alberino, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, reads the Bible as describing real vehicles. He points out that its stories mention things called the chariots of God, the chariots of Israel, or the chariots of fire, and he suggests these were craft used by angels, which would mean ancient Israelites were describing flying machines.
